# Chapter 26 – Paid in Blood

Scene 1. The crew drags the injured colonist into the airlock.

Scene 2. Laila fights for a life she knows is probably gone.

Scene 3. The death lands hardest not because it is shocking, but because everyone can see how normal the task had seemed.

Scene 4. Elena must decide what burial means when pressure volume, energy, and sentiment are all scarce.
